Name: Full costume replacement
Description: Replace a playable character body, face and materials while preserving animation and costume physics.
Warnings: Body, skeleton and Animation Blueprint must be compatible.
Material slot indexes must match the selected skeletal mesh.
Morph Target Min and Max are optional and default to 0 and 1. Locked hides a morph from runtime editing; Description explains its purpose.

Name: Costume retexture
Description: Keep the body mesh and replace only material instances.
Warnings: Do not guess material slots; inspect the skeletal mesh first.

Name: Single-mesh weapon
Description: Replace one weapon mesh and its material instances.
Warnings: The weapon component selected at runtime must be compatible with the replacement mesh.
Use WeaponActionSourceBlueprintPath only when FModel/runtime evidence proves the source Blueprint owns the compatible WeaponActionDataArray.

Name: Multi-component weapon
Description: Replace several weapon components using ComponentMatch selectors.
Warnings: Every WeaponPaths entry needs a unique and sufficiently specific ComponentMatch.
Use WeaponActionSourceBlueprintPath only when one evidenced action source is compatible with every replaced weapon component.

Name: Weapon material retexture
Description: Keep the native weapon mesh and override only its material instances.
Warnings: Set WeaponMaterialsOnly to true and do not invent a WeaponPath.

Name: Custom body with dedicated outline
Description: Load a custom body with a parallel body outline and an optional face outline skeletal mesh.
Warnings: BodyOutlinePath must reference compatible geometry and skeleton data.
FaceOutlinePath must reference a face outline mesh compatible with the in-game face.
Never place the same mesh in AuxiliaryMeshPath and BodyPath.

Name: Auxiliary mesh and component hiding
Description: Replace or hide extra native costume components that are separate from the main body.
Warnings: If AuxiliaryMeshPath is identical to BodyPath, confirm that DSMS replaces an existing component instead of spawning a duplicate.
